strips.title: A day with the Rubbermaid Brilliance — in real life

panels.head: Sunday prep
panels.text: Cook, then cool to room temperature. ATK says never seal hot food in plastic.

panels.head: Latch both sides
panels.text: Two latches clip on over the attached gasket. Flat lids stack in the fridge.

panels.head: Reheat with care
panels.text: Open the latches or vents for the microwave. ATK would rather you did not microwave plastic.

panels.head: Wash by hand
panels.text: Top rack is allowed, but cracked sets in reviews often went through the dishwasher.
